name: NHAA-SVI-ENGINE
disclaimer: This system is a decision-support and triage system, NOT a clinical or medical diagnostic system.

low.label: LOW
low.description: Limited observable distress, no immediate threat, grievance workflow continues normally.

moderate.label: MODERATE
moderate.description: Noticeable anxiety, persistent fear or emotional distress without immediate physical danger. Prioritized counselling and welfare review.

high.label: HIGH
high.description: Severe emotional distress, threats of retaliation or violence against victim/family, high vulnerability requiring prompt human review.

critical.label: CRITICAL
critical.description: Explicit self-harm/suicide ideation, active violence, or imminent life threat. Mandatory immediate human escalation.
